_comment_windows_scripts: Windows 侧的 name + scripts 覆盖块。apply.sh §3 用它整块替换 pkg.scripts —— 所以
**上游每新增一个构建链步骤,这里必须同步补**,否则那一步在 Windows 静默缺席。
这条已实撞三次(#83 check-chunk-dup/inject-preload、#86 同族、v3.9.5 patch-dom-align-zoom
与 patch_quill_domnodeinserted),故 v3.9.5 起加了常设门 `check_build_chain_parity`:
逐条比对上游 package.json 的 build/build:file/postinstall 里引用的每个 `scripts/*.js`,
少一个即发布失败。**新增步骤时改这里就够,门会替你确认没漏。**
与上游的唯一形态差异:我方走 `node scripts/umi-runner.js`(封装 NODE_OPTIONS 与 BUILD_FOR_FILE,
因为 Windows 没有 `export VAR=… &&` 这种 POSIX 前缀写法)。
name: horosa-astrostudyui

scripts.build: node scripts/patch-dom-align-zoom.js && node scripts/umi-runner.js build && node scripts/scrub-build-paths.js dist && node scripts/write-build-info.js dist && node scripts/inject-preload.js dist && node scripts/check-chunk-dup.js dist
scripts.build:file: node scripts/patch-dom-align-zoom.js && node scripts/umi-runner.js build --for-file && node scripts/scrub-build-paths.js dist-file && node scripts/write-build-info.js dist-file && node scripts/inject-preload.js dist-file && node scripts/check-chunk-dup.js dist-file
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/patch_quill_domnodeinserted.js && node scripts/patch-dom-align-zoom.js && umi generate tmp
